tasks.subject: Task 1: Complete the iOS toolchain file and wire an ios CMake preset
tasks.description:
**Goal:** cmake/toolchain/ios.cmake sets everything a Ninja-generator iOS device cross-compile needs (SDL sysroot, CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR, CMAKE_MACOSX_BUNDLE OFF), and CMakePresets.json gains an ios configure/build/workflow preset trio mirroring the emscripten32/emscripten64 pattern.

**Files:**
- Modify: cmake/toolchain/ios.cmake
- Modify: CMakePresets.json

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- cmake/toolchain/ios.cmake sets CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT, a non-empty CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR, and CMAKE_MACOSX_BUNDLE OFF
- ios configure preset inherits ninja/build, sets CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE, SOGEN_ENABLE_RUST_CODE=OFF, SOGEN_USE_SYSTEM_SDL3=OFF
- ios build preset targets only analyzer
- cmake --list-presets=all shows ios under configure, build, and workflow presets (count of 3)

**Verify:** cmake --list-presets=all | grep -c '"ios"' -> 3

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-ios-cross-compilation.md Task 1 for exact file contents and step-by-step instructions (Opus-reviewed against the real repo state).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["cmake/toolchain/ios.cmake", "CMakePresets.json"], "verifyCommand": "cmake --list-presets=all 2>&1 | grep -c '\"ios\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cmake/toolchain/ios.cmake sets CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT, CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR, CMAKE_MACOSX_BUNDLE OFF", "ios configure/build/workflow presets exist in CMakePresets.json", "cmake --list-presets=all shows ios 3 times"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Get cmake --preset=ios to configure cleanly
tasks.description:
**Goal:** cmake --preset=ios exits 0 with no errors. Iterative discovery task -- every subdirectory in src/CMakeLists.txt is processed at configure time regardless of build target. Fix real errors as they occur; gate individual add_subdirectory calls behind CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "iOS" (with a one-line comment) only when a dependency is fundamentally host/desktop-only, following the deps/vkd3d vkd3d-shader-bridge precedent. Never disable SOGEN_BUILD_TOOLS/SOGEN_BUILD_STATIC wholesale (would drop analyzer itself).

**Files:**
- Modify: src/CMakeLists.txt (only if iOS-gating needed)
- Modify: whichever CMakeLists.txt files the actual errors point to (unknown until run)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- cmake --preset=ios ends with "Build files have been written to..."
- Every iOS-gated add_subdirectory has a one-line comment explaining why
- cmake --preset=release still configures successfully afterward

**Verify:** rm -rf build/ios && cmake --preset=ios -> exits 0, ends with "Build files have been written to: <path>/build/ios"

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-ios-cross-compilation.md Task 2 for the full discovery methodology.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/CMakeLists.txt"], "verifyCommand": "rm -rf build/ios && cmake --preset=ios 2>&1 | tail -5", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cmake --preset=ios exits 0", "iOS-gated subdirectories documented with one-line comments", "cmake --preset=release still works"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Get analyzer to build for iOS
tasks.description:
**Goal:** cmake --build --preset=ios exits 0 and produces a real arm64-apple-ios analyzer Mach-O binary at build/ios/artifacts/analyzer. Iterative discovery task one layer deeper than Task 2 -- expect macOS-only API usage gated on bare __APPLE__ without TARGET_OS_IOS.

**Files:**
- Modify: whichever .cpp/.hpp files the actual compiler/linker errors point to (unknown until run)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- cmake --build --preset=ios succeeds, no errors
- file build/ios/artifacts/analyzer reports "Mach-O 64-bit executable arm64"
- Any new #if/#ifdef checks TARGET_OS_IOS, not bare __APPLE__
- cmake --build --preset=release still succeeds afterward

**Verify:** cmake --build --preset=ios 2>&1 | tail -5 && file build/ios/artifacts/analyzer -> Mach-O 64-bit executable arm64

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-ios-cross-compilation.md Task 3 for the full methodology, including the otool LC_BUILD_VERSION platform-number check (platform 2 = iOS, platform 1 = macOS).

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "cmake --build --preset=ios 2>&1 | tail -5 && file build/ios/artifacts/analyzer", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cmake --build --preset=ios succeeds", "file reports Mach-O 64-bit executable arm64", "TARGET_OS_IOS used for any new platform guards, not bare __APPLE__", "cmake --build --preset=release still succeeds"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
